senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to join, arrange, cmp. דבר,] to lead, pasture, feed; (neut. verb) to graze.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:3">Ex. R. s. 2</cite> <he>כשהיה משה … רוֹעֶה צאנו וכ׳</he> when Moses … was feeding Jethro’s flock in the desert &c.; <he>חייך אתה תִרְעֶה וכ׳</he> as thou livest, thou shalt lead my flock, Israel.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>והיה מוציא הקטנים לִרְעוֹת כדי שיִרְעוּ וכ׳</he> he (David) took out the young first that they might eat the tender grass &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:1">Yoma VI, 1</cite> <he>יִרְעֶה עד שיסתאב</he>, v. <cite ref="O00003"><he>סָאַב</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 2:9">Bekh. II, 9</cite> <he>ירעו עד וכ׳</he>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Eruvin 17a">Erub. 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 81a:1">B. Kam. 81ᵃ</cite> top <he>שיהו מַרְעִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00482"><he>חוֹרֶשׁ</he></cite>; a. e.
Jud. XIV, 20) to associate, make a friend, companion.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:9:5">Cant. R. to II, 9</cite> (ref. to <he>רעיתי</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 10">ib. 10</cite>) <he>בתו של יצחק שריעה אותי וייפה אותי וכ׳</he> the daughter of Isaac who declared me (the Lord) his friend and beautified me (the faith in God) on the altar. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 1) <he>שתָּרֵיעַ לקבל וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>שתָּרֵיעוּ</he>; from <he>רעע</he>, v. <cite ref="T00670"><he>רֵיעַ</he></cite>) that thou (you) form a partnership &c., v. <cite ref="U01998"><he>שָׂרַע</he></cite>.
